trigger: V1 native tread-detail actual reading found triangular tongues/shelves at crossings of unequal and tapered depth fields. Kept as G3 rework, not dismissed as reflection.
method: Let a,b,c>=0 be the original three authored depth fields. Replace max(a,b,c) at overlaps by (a^4+b^4+c^4)^(1/4), retaining exact single-field depth and zero outside their union. Additional inward depth bounded by maxdepth*(3^(1/4)-1). No new channels or normal-map camouflage.
scope_limits: Nominal3.00-17/TL and all original dimensional estimates unchanged.
No outer diameter, width, sidewall or bead adjustment.
Author analytical crown normals are recomputed from the corrected surface, never GLB tangent repairs.
Existing constraint-aligned triangulation retained initially; sample approximation and native macros must pass before accepting the revised candidate.
No exact brand/mould/repetition assigned from unreadable official photos.
Expanded correction mask includes original bad tail imprints, without new groove support. All vertices outside the expanded mask and all sidewall/bead/original land vertices remain exact.
comparison: global dimensions and bounded extra depth
gray and narrow reflection native macros at originaljunctioncamera
strict actualGLB closure/area/UV/T and native sections

termination_correction.reason: b starts atax6.5mm and reachesfull depthat12mm while mainlane is10±2.4mm; a short b tail may cross to opposite crown. c can overshoot outward similarly.
termination_correction.gate: g=smoothstep(lane-bottom,lane+bottom,absX), bottom=mainwidth/2-lip=0.45mm in the current authored estimates. b*=g, c*=1-g. Both terminate in the existing longitudinal groove flat-floor band.
termination_correction.mask: Original multi-family overlaps plus old positive b/c support where these gates change the fields. Not just original overlaps. All other source vertices remain exact.
termination_correction.restoration: Depth can decrease locally toward the same reference crown; maximum restoration bounded by original3.4mm field depth. No new positive-depth support permitted.
